svg.text: WebSocket Client Architecture — LLD
Connection Management & Reconnection
WebSocket lifecycle: CONNECTING(0) → OPEN(1) → CLOSING(2) → CLOSED(3)
Singleton connection: one WS per app (or per logical channel) — not per component
Exponential backoff: 1s → 2s → 4s → 8s → max 30s with jitter
Max retries: cap at 10; after that show "offline" banner + manual reconnect
Ping/pong heartbeat: client sends ping every 25s; server replies pong
Missed pong detection: if no pong in 5s → close + reconnect
Visibility API: pause heartbeat on document.hidden; reconnect on visibilitychange
Online/offline events: navigator.onLine check before reconnect attempt
Message Protocol & Queuing
Message envelope: {type, id, payload, timestamp} — typed discriminated union
Message ID: UUID per message; server echoes id for ACK correlation
Outbound queue: buffer messages when CONNECTING; flush on OPEN
Queue overflow: cap at 100 messages; drop oldest or reject with error
Request-response over WS: send id → store Promise resolve in pendingMap
ACK timeout: if no response in 5s → reject promise + log error
Serialization: JSON for flexibility; MessagePack/Protobuf for high-throughput
Binary frames: Blob or ArrayBuffer for file chunks, audio, canvas data
Subscription Model & React Integration
Publisher/subscriber: ws.subscribe(type, handler) → returns unsubscribe fn
React hook: useWebSocket(url) → { status, send, lastMessage }
useEffect cleanup: unsubscribe on unmount to prevent stale handler leaks
Context provider: wrap app in WSProvider; components subscribe via hook
Selective re-render: useWebSocket returns stable refs; avoid top-level state updates
Optimistic state: apply WS update locally; roll back if server sends error
Deduplication: track seen message IDs (Set) — server may replay on reconnect
Ordering: sequence numbers; hold out-of-order messages until gap filled
Auth, Security & Transport Fallback
Auth: pass token in connection URL query param (wss://host?token=X) or first message
Token refresh: on 4401 close code → refresh token → reconnect with new token
TLS: always wss:// — plaintext ws:// only in localhost dev
Origin validation: server checks Origin header to block cross-site WS hijack
SSE fallback: if WS blocked (proxy/firewall) fall back to Server-Sent Events
Long-polling fallback: last resort; adds 1 RTT latency per message
Rate limiting: client-side debounce on sends; server drops clients exceeding N msg/s
Memory: remove old messages from store; cap history at N entries
Exponential backoff: 1s→2s→4s→30s with jitter
Outbound queue: buffer on CONNECTING, flush on OPEN
useEffect cleanup: unsubscribe to prevent handler leaks
Always wss://; Origin validation against CSWSH
SSE fallback when WS blocked by proxy/firewall
